Global economic growth projected at 3.3% in 2025 and 3.2% in 2026; Indian economy projected to grow at 6.5% in FY2024-25 and 6.7% in FY2025-26. Global plastic furniture market valued at USD 15.5 billion in 2024, projected to reach USD 17.5 billion by 2028 at CAGR 6.9%. Indian plastic furniture market valued at Rs 9.15 lakh crore in 2024, projected to reach Rs 20.5 lakh crore by 2032.

Global circular economy market forecast to grow from $517.79 billion in 2025 to $578.79 billion in 2026 at CAGR of 11.6%, and to $888.22 billion in 2030 at CAGR of 11.3%. Global recycled plastic market valued at $47.98 billion in 2024, expected to reach $65.95 billion by 2028 and $158.16 billion by 2034 at CAGR of 15.8%. India waste plastic recycling market at 11.92 Million Tons in 2024, expected to reach 25.88 Million Tons by 2034 at CAGR of 9.00%.
